market.title: Market now
market.subtitle: Official data from the Bank of Israel and the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS).
market.boiRateHelp: The rate set by the Bank of Israel — the basis for the prime rate.
market.primeRateHelp: The Bank of Israel rate plus 1.5 percentage points. The basis for prime-track loans.
market.nextDecisionHelp: The next scheduled date on which the Bank of Israel sets the interest rate.
market.cpiHelp: The latest monthly change in the CPI. It affects CPI-linked mortgage tracks.
market.forecastHelp: The Bank of Israel Research Department's forecast for the pace of price increases.
market.sourceDerived: Derived from the Bank of Israel rate

calculator.title: Mortgage Calculator
calculator.subtitle: Monthly payment calculation for a mortgage mix — one or more fixed-rate unlinked tracks, using the Spitzer or equal-principal method.
calculator.repaymentMethodsHelp: With Spitzer the total payment is generally stable while the split between principal and interest changes over time. With equal principal the same principal amount is repaid each month, so the payment starts higher and decreases over time.
calculator.trackAmountHelp: The part of the mortgage repaid under this track's terms. The total mortgage is the sum of all tracks.
calculator.fixedLinkedHelp: The interest rate is fixed for the full term, but the principal and payments are linked to the Consumer Price Index.
calculator.trackTypeHelp: The track type determines how the interest behaves. In a fixed unlinked track the payment is known in advance; in a prime track the rate moves with the Bank of Israel rate.
calculator.governmentBondHelp: The rate remains fixed until the reset date and then updates according to a government-bond anchor. The principal is not CPI-linked.
calculator.makamHelp: The rate updates annually according to the Makam anchor plus the contractual margin. The principal is not CPI-linked.
calculator.makamAnchorUnavailableNote: The Makam anchor saved in this link is currently unavailable, so the calculation was not performed. You can update to the latest anchor.
calculator.stressScenarioNote: Results reflect a scenario you defined, not the official forecast.
calculator.negativeRatesNote: This is a stress scenario, not a likely forecast.
calculator.curveUnavailableNote: The forecast curve saved in this link is currently unavailable, so the calculation was not performed. You can update the calculation to the latest curve.
calculator.repaymentMethodHelp: How the loan is repaid: Spitzer — a generally stable total payment; equal principal — a payment that starts higher and decreases over time.
calculator.yearsHelp: A longer duration lowers the monthly payment but increases the total interest.
calculator.interestRateHelp: The nominal annual rate exactly as the bank quotes it in the offer.
calculator.invalidInput: Invalid input. Make sure every track has a valid amount, rate, and duration.
calculator.fieldErrorYearsInvalidForReset: This term is not available for the selected reset frequency
calculator.totalPaymentHelp: All payments combined: the borrowed principal plus all the interest.
calculator.totalInterestHelp: How much you pay the bank on top of what you borrowed, over the whole term.
calculator.effectiveRateHelp: The effective annual rate after accounting for monthly compounding.
calculator.copyScenarioLinkFallback: Couldn't copy automatically. Please copy the address from your browser's address bar.
calculator.compareComingSoonLabel: Compare with another scenario — coming soon
calculator.mixHelp: Each track is calculated independently, and the total monthly payment is the sum of the tracks still active in that month. When a shorter track ends, the combined monthly payment goes down.
calculator.weightedRateNote: The weighted rate is calculated using each track's opening balance for that month.
calculator.forecastScheduleTitle: Forecast payment schedule based on the Bank of Israel curve
calculator.forecastScheduleNote: The forecast schedule is based on the Bank of Israel curve, so its projected month-1 payment may differ from the first payment calculated using today's rate.
calculator.stabilityDimensionsHelp: An internal score that summarizes rate stability, principal stability, and payment predictability. It is meant for comparing scenarios and is not financial advice.
calculator.stabilityDisclaimer: The stability index is an internal educational measure based on the track structure. It is not an official score, does not measure mortgage cost and is not a recommendation.
scheduleIntro: Every monthly payment is split in two: principal and interest. The principal is the part that reduces your loan balance; the interest is the price you pay the bank for the money.
With the Spitzer method the monthly payment is nearly constant, but its composition changes: early payments are mostly interest, while later payments mostly reduce the principal.
The remaining balance after each month is the principal you still owe the bank following that payment.
calculator.scheduleScrollHint: Scroll sideways to see principal, interest, and balance.
calculator.freshnessIntro: These details show which sources were used for rates and forecasts and when they were last checked.
calculator.disclaimer: This is a monthly simulation for illustration only, not a binding bank offer.
